rules.rule: Product cards: high-quality image top 60% of card, product name in 16sp medium, price in 18sp bold, add-to-cart button below. 2-column grid default, 1-column list option.
Add to Cart and Buy Now must be high-contrast, full-width at bottom of product detail screen. Never below the fold on first scroll. Use distinct colors for each.
Trust signals near purchase actions: star rating with count, verified purchase badges, free shipping callout, secure checkout lock icon. These reduce cart abandonment.
Search bar at top of home, prominent filter/sort options. Category pills horizontally scrollable below search. Recent searches and trending shown when search is empty.
Checkout: step indicator at top (1. Cart → 2. Address → 3. Payment → 4. Confirm), order summary always visible, total price with breakdown. One-tap payment at final step.
